title: Print the plan of a Compose seat
command:
python3 scripts/tenant_pi.py compose-plan --uid 1000 --gid 1000 \
  --public-key "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/seat-key.pub" \
  --gateway-url https://gateway.example.invalid/v1 \
  --private-dir "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi" \
  --model codex-auto/astra | \
  python3 -m json.tool | \
  sed '/"step": "build"/q'
